title: General Settings
description: Adjust global application parameters and manage your configuration.

llm.title: LLM Provider Settings
llm.description: Adjust global settings for interaction with Large Language Models.
llm.apiUrlDescription: Auto-fills when changing provider. Modify if using a proxy or non-standard endpoint.
llm.apiUrlTooltip: The base URL for requests to the LLM provider. For local models (LM Studio, Ollama), this is typically a local address (e.g., http://localhost:1234/v1).
llm.apiKeyTooltip: Your API key for the selected LLM provider. It's stored securely in your browser.
llm.modelNamePlaceholderLocal: Select or type a model (e.g: local-model-name) ({provider})
llm.modelNameDescriptionLocal: For {provider}, common models are listed, but you can also type one directly if it doesn't appear.
llm.modelNameTooltip: The specific model from the LLM provider to use. For Groq, an attempt is made to fetch the list dynamically.

git.title: Git Settings (Optional)
git.description: Configure details for features interacting with Git repositories.
git.repoUrlTooltip: The full HTTPS URL of your remote Git repository (e.g., GitHub, GitLab).
git.usernameTooltip: Your Git username that will be used for commits.
git.emailTooltip: Your email address associated with your Git commits.
git.patTooltip: A Personal Access Token (PAT) from your Git provider (e.g., GitHub) with repository write permissions. Treat it like a password.

language.title: Application Language
language.description: Select the language for the user interface.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Activates a detailed log panel at the bottom of the application.

saved.title: Settings Saved
saved.description: Your settings have been saved locally.

llmConnectionSuccess.title: Connection Successful
llmConnectionSuccess.description: The connection with the LLM provider works.

llmConnectionError.title: Connection Failed
llmConnectionError.description: Could not connect to the LLM provider. Check your settings.

gitConnectionSuccess.title: Git Connection Successful
gitConnectionSuccess.description: The connection with the Git repository works.

gitConnectionError.title: Git Connection Failed
gitConnectionError.description: Could not connect to the Git repository. Check URL and credentials.

configImported.title: Configuration Imported
configImported.description: Configuration has been imported and applied.

languageChanged.title: Language Changed
languageChanged.description: Application language has been set to {langName}.

groqModelsLoadNoModels.title: No Groq Models
groqModelsLoadNoModels.description: No models found for the provided Groq API key.

groqModelsLoadError.title: Error Loading Groq Models
groqModelsLoadError.description: Could not load Groq models. Error: {error}
